title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Reversal of Paid Claim Lines and Monthly Cost Shares
content:
## Rule

A reversal withdraws exactly one paid Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) line or one cost share, identified by its own record, at most once. When the only paid ECHO claim of a family month is reversed, that month's cost share is reversed too. A paid line or cost share is reversed at most once.

## What a reversal books

- **Reversal of a paid line.** It names the paid line it reverses, with that line's claim number and line number, and withdraws the government share of that line; the amount withdrawn comes off the beneficiary's ECHO benefit used.
- **Reversal of a cost share.** It names the monthly cost share it reverses and that cost share's month, and withdraws the amount from the cost shares assessed to the family. A cost share is withdrawn when it was assessed in error, when it is a second assessment in the same family month, or when the only claim of the month is reversed.

## The once-only condition

A paid line or cost share is reversed at most once. Whether the paid line or cost share has already been reversed is read from the ECHO ledger before the reversal: a reversal of a paid line or of a cost share that already names the same record means it has been reversed.

| The record named for reversal | Already named by an earlier reversal on the ledger | Reversal of that record |
|---|---|---|
| a paid ECHO line | no | may be booked, once |
| a paid ECHO line | yes | not booked again |
| a monthly cost share | no | may be booked, once |
| a monthly cost share | yes | not booked again |

## Basis Q&A

**Does one reversal cover several lines of the same claim?** No. A reversal withdraws exactly one paid line, identified by its own record.

**When does reversing a claim also reverse the cost share?** When it is the only paid ECHO claim of the family month: that month's cost share is reversed too.

*Hypothetical case, for illustration only:* a sponsor family has exactly one paid ECHO claim in April, and it carried April's cost share. When that claim is reversed, April's cost share is reversed too. If the family had a second paid ECHO claim in April, the reversed claim would not be the only paid ECHO claim of that family month.
